class.name: CgameProceduralCaves
class.brief_description: Cellular-automata cave generator with guaranteed connectivity.
class.description: [CgameProceduralCaves] is a native port of the GDScript [code]procedural_caves.gd[/code] library. A cave is a [PackedByteArray] of [code]width * height[/code] cells (index [code]y * width + x[/code]) where [code]1[/code] is rock and [code]0[/code] is open floor. [method generate] fills the grid randomly, smooths it with an 8-neighbour majority rule and joins every disconnected region to the largest one with an L-shaped tunnel between the closest cells. The result is deterministic for a given seed. Smoothing is distributed over the [WorkerThreadPool] for large grids without changing the result.

method.name: chambers
method.description: Returns the centre of every open region with at least [param min_size] cells as an [Array] of [Vector2] (cell coordinates), snapped to the nearest open cell of the region and ordered by region size, largest first. Good spots for loot, bosses or spawners.

method.name: generate
method.description: Generates a cave. The border is always rock. [param fill] is the initial probability of a rock cell and [param steps] the number of smoothing passes. Sizes below 3 are clamped to 3.

method.name: regions
method.description: Flood-fills the open cells (4-connected) and returns one [PackedInt32Array] of cell indices per region, ordered by discovery. Returns an empty array if the grid size does not match [code]w * h[/code].
